pulls.title: Show sales tax and line totals on receipts
pulls.author: fede
pulls.body:
Closes #32.

Each receipt line now shows its line total, and the receipt ends with a tax line computed from the order's `taxRate`.

pulls.title: Receipts in the order's currency
pulls.author: bruno
pulls.body:
Closes #30.

Renames `formatPrice` to `formatMoney(cents, currency = 'USD')`, formatted with Intl, and threads the order's `currency` through everything that prints an amount. Adds examples/berlin-order.json.

issues.title: Berlin store needs EUR receipts
issues.author: carla
issues.body: The Berlin store opens next month. Every amount on its receipts must be in EUR (orders carry `currency: "EUR"`). Showing $ on a German receipt is a compliance problem.

issues.title: Receipts must show sales tax
issues.author: dana
issues.body: Receipts need a tax line (rate from the order's `taxRate`) and each line's total, so customers can check the math.
